correctness.rationale: Column-wise binary carry conservation proves the event C≤k. A carry entering any inter-one zero run has already consumed at least one carry; after k further zeros no surviving state can keep a carry. The shortened run preserves the entire retained carry-count distribution, giving a finite k-gap domain and attainment. An exact no-floating-point 5,063,361-case full enumeration reproduces the eight minima and all canonical optimizers, with a separate Fraction implementation independently checking initial cases and compression examples. All statements have explicit quantifiers and bounds; unproved k≥9 exact values are excluded.
